row.name: Smart_car_parking_IOT
row.description: This is a College project app, Project name : Smart car parking Station with Mobile application in this project we make a station where when any car came in parking slot then sensor will send data  to the nodemcu and Nodemcu will send data to firebase and you can see live update of parking system int his app
